name: Ref
description: Ref searches public and private documentation and returns only the relevant part of a page, which keeps the agent's context small.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (ref.scalekit.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
